tax_rates_rate_or_stop.name: tax_rates_rate_or_stop
tax_rates_rate_or_stop.value:
("tax_rates"."stop" and "tax_rates"."rate_percent" is null)
        or (not "tax_rates"."stop" and "tax_rates"."rate_percent" > 0 and "tax_rates"."rate_percent" <= 100
            and cardinality("tax_rates"."categories") > 0)

tax_rates_verified_complete.name: tax_rates_verified_complete
tax_rates_verified_complete.value: ("tax_rates"."verified_by_name" is null) = ("tax_rates"."verified_on" is null) and ("tax_rates"."verified_on" is null) = ("tax_rates"."verified_source" is null)

taxes_scope.name: taxes_scope
taxes_scope.value:
("taxes"."kind" = 'vat' and "taxes"."state_code" is null and "taxes"."property_id" is null)
        or ("taxes"."kind" = 'state_tax' and "taxes"."state_code" is not null and "taxes"."property_id" is null)
        or ("taxes"."kind" = 'service_charge' and "taxes"."state_code" is null and "taxes"."property_id" is not null)

guest_id_documents_attached.name: guest_id_documents_attached
guest_id_documents_attached.value: "guest_id_documents"."status" = 'pending' or "guest_id_documents"."purged_at" is not null or ("guest_id_documents"."guest_id" is not null and "guest_id_documents"."attached_at" is not null)

guest_registrations_id_number.name: guest_registrations_id_number
guest_registrations_id_number.value: ("guest_registrations"."id_number_cipher" is null) = ("guest_registrations"."id_number_masked" is null) and ("guest_registrations"."visa_number_cipher" is null) = ("guest_registrations"."visa_number_masked" is null)

rate_dates_price.name: rate_dates_price
rate_dates_price.value: "rate_dates"."price" is null or ("rate_dates"."price" > 0 and "rate_dates"."price" <= 100000000 and "rate_dates"."price" = trunc("rate_dates"."price"))

rate_dates_season_name.name: rate_dates_season_name
rate_dates_season_name.value: "rate_dates"."season_name" is null or char_length("rate_dates"."season_name") between 1 and 40

rate_dates_not_empty.name: rate_dates_not_empty
rate_dates_not_empty.value: "rate_dates"."price" is not null or "rate_dates"."closed" or "rate_dates"."closed_to_arrival" or "rate_dates"."min_stay" is not null or "rate_dates"."season_name" is not null

rate_plan_room_types_prices.name: rate_plan_room_types_prices
rate_plan_room_types_prices.value:
("rate_plan_room_types"."weekday_price" is null or ("rate_plan_room_types"."weekday_price" > 0 and "rate_plan_room_types"."weekday_price" <= 100000000 and "rate_plan_room_types"."weekday_price" = trunc("rate_plan_room_types"."weekday_price")))
        and ("rate_plan_room_types"."weekend_price" is null or ("rate_plan_room_types"."weekday_price" is not null and "rate_plan_room_types"."weekend_price" > 0 and "rate_plan_room_types"."weekend_price" <= 100000000 and "rate_plan_room_types"."weekend_price" = trunc("rate_plan_room_types"."weekend_price")))

rate_plans_pricing.name: rate_plans_pricing
rate_plans_pricing.value:
("rate_plans"."pricing" = 'own' and "rate_plans"."parent_id" is null and "rate_plans"."adjustment_percent" is null and "rate_plans"."adjustment_amount" is null)
        or ("rate_plans"."pricing" = 'derived' and "rate_plans"."parent_id" is not null and "rate_plans"."parent_id" <> "rate_plans"."id"
          and ("rate_plans"."adjustment_percent" is null) <> ("rate_plans"."adjustment_amount" is null) and "rate_plans"."extra_adult" is null)

rate_plans_adjustment_range.name: rate_plans_adjustment_range
rate_plans_adjustment_range.value:
("rate_plans"."adjustment_percent" is null or "rate_plans"."adjustment_percent" between -90 and 100)
        and ("rate_plans"."adjustment_amount" is null or ("rate_plans"."adjustment_amount" = trunc("rate_plans"."adjustment_amount") and abs("rate_plans"."adjustment_amount") <= 100000000))

rate_plans_meal_allocation.name: rate_plans_meal_allocation
rate_plans_meal_allocation.value:
("rate_plans"."meal_plan" = 'room_only') = ("rate_plans"."meal_allocation" is null)
        and ("rate_plans"."meal_allocation" is null or "rate_plans"."meal_allocation" > 0)

rate_plans_cancellation.name: rate_plans_cancellation
rate_plans_cancellation.value:
("rate_plans"."cancellation_kind" = 'non_refundable' and "rate_plans"."cancellation_hours" is null and "rate_plans"."cancellation_penalty" is null and "rate_plans"."cancellation_percent" is null)
        or ("rate_plans"."cancellation_kind" = 'free_until' and "rate_plans"."cancellation_hours" between 0 and 720 and "rate_plans"."cancellation_penalty" is not null
          and ("rate_plans"."cancellation_penalty" = 'percent_of_stay') = ("rate_plans"."cancellation_percent" is not null))

rate_plans_deposit.name: rate_plans_deposit
rate_plans_deposit.value:
("rate_plans"."deposit_kind" = 'none' and "rate_plans"."deposit_due" is null and "rate_plans"."deposit_percent" is null and "rate_plans"."deposit_due_hours" is null)
        or ("rate_plans"."deposit_kind" <> 'none' and "rate_plans"."deposit_due" is not null
          and ("rate_plans"."deposit_kind" = 'percent_of_stay') = ("rate_plans"."deposit_percent" is not null)
          and ("rate_plans"."deposit_due" = 'within_hours') = ("rate_plans"."deposit_due_hours" is not null))

rate_plans_percent_range.name: rate_plans_percent_range
rate_plans_percent_range.value:
("rate_plans"."cancellation_percent" is null or "rate_plans"."cancellation_percent" between 0.01 and 100)
        and ("rate_plans"."deposit_percent" is null or "rate_plans"."deposit_percent" between 0.01 and 100)

guests_contact.name: guests_contact
guests_contact.value: "guests"."phone" is not null or "guests"."email" is not null

guests_names.name: guests_names
guests_names.value: char_length("guests"."first_name") between 1 and 60 and char_length("guests"."last_name") between 1 and 60

penalties_waived.name: penalties_waived
penalties_waived.value: ("penalties"."status" = 'waived') = ("penalties"."waived_at" is not null and "penalties"."waived_by_name" is not null and "penalties"."waiver_reason" is not null and "penalties"."waiver_business_date" is not null)

reservations_end_text_length.name: reservations_end_text_length
reservations_end_text_length.value: ("reservations"."end_reason_text" is null or char_length("reservations"."end_reason_text") <= 200) and ("reservations"."end_note" is null or char_length("reservations"."end_note") <= 500)

stays_checked_in.name: stays_checked_in
stays_checked_in.value: "stays"."status" <> 'checked_in' or ("stays"."room_id" is not null and "stays"."checked_in_at" is not null and "stays"."checked_in_by_name" is not null and "stays"."checked_in_business_date" is not null)

room_out_of_order_text_length.name: room_out_of_order_text_length
room_out_of_order_text_length.value: ("room_out_of_order"."reason_text" is null or char_length("room_out_of_order"."reason_text") <= 100) and ("room_out_of_order"."note" is null or char_length("room_out_of_order"."note") <= 200)
